main_measure.name: mean signed excess 3-bar return on non-overlapping grid bars with |forecast| >= 5
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of signed excess 3-bar return on |forecast|, positive with t >= 1

decided_by: The mean signed excess 3-bar return is above 0 with t >= 2 and the slope on |forecast| is positive with t >= 1.
reading: The plan's volatility rule is read from the recorded regime ('mean_reversion' = 20-day vol rank >= 0.8) and a 'large move' bar is any bar with a non-zero one-day move faded by the forecast's sign; the coin's mean 3-bar return is the mean over all non-overlapping grid bars of all its windows; the plan's 'fewer than 30 qualifying cases' is treated as a minimum count giving 'not observable'.
